report.summary: Plan: 5 items to fix budget-tracking gap, dominance-dilution, exclusion-gap, missing-default-config, duplicate-identity-evasion.
risks: Settling checks may reveal no issue; items 1 and 3 could become no-ops.
Item 5 depends on unknown actor.id hashing; may be unactionable.
todos: Inspect daedalus/lanes/fanout.py for paid_calls consistency; fix if missing.
Inspect daedalus/structcore/markdown.py's code_modules to verify document filtering.
Inspect daedalus/lanes/checks.py for file extension early-return logic.
Investigate daedalus/council/vendors.py actor.id hashing for config inclusion.

items.title: Fix paid_calls key inconsistency in fan_out return
items.why_now: Confirmed high-severity: successful return omits 'paid_calls', risking KeyError in callers.

steps.do: Audit daedalus/lanes/fanout.py for all return paths of _run_task or fan_out; ensure 'paid_calls' is present in every successful return (set to 0 if no calls).
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'paid_calls' daedalus/lanes/fanout.py and confirm both success and refusal returns have the key; run existing fanout tests.

items.assumption: The missing key is indeed a bug; if caller uses .get() it may be harmless.

items.title: Verify and fix dominance fraction denominator inflation from documents
items.why_now: High-severity narrowed claim: if code_modules includes documents, dominance fraction is inflated, affecting fenced dominance logic.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/structcore/markdown.py's code_modules function to see if it filters out non-code files (e.g., markdown documents).
steps.verified_by: Read the function body; if documents are included, add filtering to exclude .md files. Run graph brief tests to confirm denominator unchanged.

items.assumption: code_modules is the function used by _graph_nodes; if not, adjust inspection target.

items.title: Add early-return guards for non-Python files in checks.py
items.why_now: Medium-severity narrowed claim: checks may incorrectly apply to C/C++ files without proper early return.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/lanes/checks.py functions parses, not_truncated, no_elision, not_substituted for file extension checks; add early return for non-Python files if missing.
steps.verified_by: Write a unit test that passes a .c file to each function and asserts they return a pass/empty result (not a failure). Run existing checks tests.

items.assumption: The functions are designed only for Python; if they already handle other languages correctly, no change needed.

items.title: Define or import DEFAULT_NUM_CTX in switches.py
items.why_now: Medium-severity narrowed claim: reference to undefined constant could cause NameError at runtime.

steps.do: Search daedalus/mapping/switches.py for 'DEFAULT_NUM_CTX'; if not defined, add definition (e.g., import from providers/ollama.py or define locally).
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'DEFAULT_NUM_CTX' daedalus/mapping/switches.py; if added, run mapping drift tests.

items.assumption: The constant is expected to be defined in the same file; if it is already imported, no change needed.

items.title: Ensure actor.id includes full configuration hash to prevent duplicate identity evasion
items.why_now: Low-severity narrowed claim: identical configs could produce different IDs if hash does not cover config.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/council/vendors.py to see how actor.id is computed; if it does not include the full configuration (model, temperature, etc.), add hashing of the config dict.
steps.verified_by: Write a unit test that creates two actors with identical configs and asserts they have the same ID; run council vendor tests.

items.assumption: The actor.id is currently computed from model name only; if it already includes config, no change needed.
